Chapter 6010: Run Back To Your Clan

Chapter 6010: Run Back To Your Clan

The manager’s tenacity didn’t yield in the face of death.

“Very well, we will kill you and take the treasures either way. Splendor Terra shall be no more after today.” The Ouyang Clan Master shouted.

His clan had absolute control of the situation due to the appearance of Dragonform Grand Emperor. The other dynasties didn’t have anyone stronger and furthermore, he had ten sacred fruits - enough to fight anyone here.

Their clan was going to get the lion’s share of the treasuries, so he wanted to accelerate the process.

“Move, move, our young noble is here.” An imperial aura swept forward and broke through the barricade.

Minisun Emperor led the way, followed by Li Qiye and a man carrying a statue.

The strange group surprised the crowd momentarily. Once they regained their wits, all eyes were on Minisun Emperor.

A mortal such as Li Qiye was not worth mentioning. As for Sky Step King, he was still a junior with no authority here. The statue on his back did draw some attention.

“Minisun Emperor.” Ghost-eyed and the others became anxious.

“Two emperors from Enigma now.” They didn’t like this development since it favored Enigma.

“Minisun, why are you here? Does your dynasty wish to monopolize the fortress?” Ghost-eyed said aggressively.

Minisun didn’t say anything while Li Qiye glanced at the three layers of treasures first before staring at the manager’s group.

The latter was beaten and exhausted, no longer having the strength to put up a fight. The next wave would be the last.

“Sigh, taking someone else’s things isn’t easy.” Li Qiye shook his head before gesturing at the crowd: “Leave, there’s no business here for any of you now. Don’t be dumb.”

Others were wary of Dragonform and Minisun, but this mortal?

“Who are you?” Dragonform stared at him and noticed the ten bracelets on his arm.

“Brother, you have gotten what you want, leave now.” Minisun told him.

Dragonform’s expression changed dramatically because this thing shouldn’t appear in the possession of a mortal. He scowled and left without saying anything. After all, he had achieved his goal.

“Ancestor!” The clan master of the Ouyang shouted at him. Alas, this didn’t work and they have lost their backer.

“Bye now.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Who the hell do you think you are? Know your place!” A cultivator snorted.

“Bam!” The flood tiger grabbed and tossed him into its mouth, devouring him in no time at all.

Its strange mouth with eight petals and countless teeth naturally frightened everyone.

“Anyone else got something to say? Leave instead of making this place your grave.” Li Qiye smiled again.

“Brat, state your name!” Mountainbreak and the others still didn’t respect a mortal.

“Just a kind passerby who doesn’t want all of you to die a gruesome death. Don’t make me change my mind and do it myself.” Li Qiye said.

Their eyes widened in disbelief after listening to him.

“Hahaha, you?” Innumerable Saint’s eyes were fixated on him.

“Don’t need anyone else, but you bunch aren’t worthy of the honor.” Li Qiye said.

This was the first time they listened to such an arrogant mortal. They always viewed mortals as insects but it seemed the opposite was happening today.

“I can’t tell if you’re a hidden master or just pure ignorant.” Ghost-eyed smiled coldly.

“I will kill you either way, not before I flay your skin and drink your blood.” The Ouyang Clan Master threatened.

“Tsk, tsk, in such a hurry to die just like your son. Want to join him in my dog’s stomach?” Li Qiye said and patted the flood tiger’s head.

The tiger sneered at him, causing his eyes to turn red since he finally found out the reason for his son’s death.

“Brat, I will make you wish you were dead!” He stepped forward and the overwhelming aura of a desolate god surged forth like a landslide.

“Run back to your clan!” Minisun shouted, breaking his aura with her own.

Powerful cultivators such as Breakmountain and Innumerable staggered backward while others felt suffocated.

“Fellow Daoist, it is unwise of you to be protecting this brat.” The clan master said.

He had ten sacred fruits and should be just as strong. However, she was a member of Enigma.

“Fine, have it your way. You and your clan shall be eradicated.” Minisun’s eyes turned cold.

The clan master certainly didn’t expect such a strong response from her.
